_meta.policy: Open review items are published, not hidden. A flag does not by itself block publication unless it makes a specific claim unsafe; unsafe claims are left blank or rejected.

flags.title: Bank FX classification vs nationality vs tax residence
flags.detail: A U.S. citizen with a still-active PRC resident ID may be classified inconsistently. Resolve with the bank/SAFE before using any quota or overseas-person route.

flags.title: No executable CNY-to-USD quote for the user's amount/date
flags.detail: All FX cost and all-in USD totals remain blank. The BOC board is indicative only and its ask was below its reference rate.

flags.title: Unknown source-of-funds and tax history
flags.detail: The balance may contain salary, property gain, dividends, gifts or already-taxed principal. Personalized tax cannot be computed.

flags.title: Old staged emigrant-release rule superseded
flags.detail: 2004 text staged releases; amended 2014 rules removed the staged requirement. Edition D uses the amended rule and 2024-based service guides.

flags.title: Local SAFE document practice varies
flags.detail: Service guides are official but local offices may request additional evidence; apostille/consular practice depends on documents and treaties.

flags.title: Emigrant route only covers pre-status property
flags.detail: Property acquired after immigration needs another basis; do not assume the whole current balance qualifies.

flags.title: Inheritance guide internal eligibility copy irregularity
flags.detail: SAFE Hebei inheritance guide's eligibility section appears to copy emigrant pre-status wording, while its definition and cited law correctly describe inheritance. Flagged rather than silently corrected.

flags.title: Property-sale local implementation
flags.detail: Local tax/SAFE checklists and later housing policies must be confirmed for the specific city and sale date.

flags.title: Housing assessed-rate alternative is not a default
flags.detail: 1%-3% assessed taxation applies only where original value cannot be verified and the tax authority assesses; do not present it as a universal rate.

flags.title: Insurance payout character
flags.detail: Only lawful compliant insurance proceeds are covered by the SAFE FAQ; surrender/investment products may differ.

flags.title: Reconversion requires original exchange trail
flags.detail: Long-held CNY savings without an original FX exchange memo do not qualify for the 24-month reconversion route.

flags.title: Already-FX return is not CNY conversion
flags.detail: Listed separately to avoid double-counting; it does not solve a CNY balance.

flags.title: Quota is not a capital-account savings export right
flags.detail: Domestic-person quota and above-quota current-account purchases require genuine current-account purposes; splitting and false purposes are prohibited.

flags.title: Trade/service routes require real transactions
flags.detail: Fabricated contracts/invoices are prohibited; tax filing may apply.

flags.title: Published sender fees are not all-in costs
flags.detail: FX spread, correspondent/receiver charges, taxes and document costs are separate and mostly unknown.

flags.title: BOC full-arrival service is conditional
flags.detail: USD15/25 applies only where intermediary routing applies and the receiving bank condition is met; other overseas charges may still be actual.

flags.title: Draft collection risk
flags.detail: U.S. bank acceptance, collection fees, delay and loss/stop-payment risk are unverified.

flags.title: HSBC segment eligibility and relationship costs
flags.detail: Premier/Advance/Private Banking status, monthly fees and Advance opening restrictions affect availability and total cost.

flags.title: Global Transfer moves FX, not CNY entitlement
flags.detail: CNY must first be lawfully purchased into USD; corridor and per-transfer limits must be confirmed.

flags.title: Wise is not a mainland-national quota workaround
flags.detail: Eligibility requires non-mainland-Chinese status, China work/tax records and own-account destination; overall limit is documented net income.

flags.title: Wise per-transfer and overall limits
flags.detail: Bank app CNY300k / Alipay CNY50k per transfer; overall limit depends on tax records and prior transfers.

flags.title: Wise current full fee schedule unverified
flags.detail: Only four public source-amount quotes were observed; they are not locked and do not verify a 40-point schedule. Historical Nov-2024 formulas are not used as current.

flags.title: Wise Alipay current fee unverified
flags.detail: No current numeric schedule verified; live quote required.

flags.title: WU bank-account payout temporarily unavailable
flags.detail: Only cash pickup was verified on the China outbound page; cash collection/deposit adds compliance and fees.

flags.title: WU China-outbound fees/FX unverified
flags.detail: No numeric fee schedule or executable quote verified.

flags.title: Overseas ATM cash caps make large targets impractical
flags.detail: CNY100k/person/year and CNY10k/card/day caps apply; borrowing cards is prohibited.

flags.title: BOC future ATM pricing not current on research date
flags.detail: Mastercard/Visa 2.5% min USD3/max USD40 starts 2026-11-11; do not apply it on 2026-11-08.

flags.title: HSBC ATM segment/network differences
flags.detail: Premier HSBC ATMs free; UnionPay formula differs; foreign surcharges may apply.

flags.title: Cash export above USD10k generally prohibited
flags.detail: Special-case SAFE permit required; frequent-traveler lower caps apply. Do not treat cash as a large-balance workaround.

flags.title: U.S. cash declaration and deposit
flags.detail: Over USD10k entering/leaving the U.S. requires FinCEN 105; U.S. bank deposit policies vary.

flags.title: MoneyGram China corridor unverified
flags.detail: Generic agent page does not verify CNY funding, USD payout, own-account eligibility, limits or fees.

flags.title: PayPal C2 repatriation unverified
flags.detail: International payment capability does not establish CNY bank-funded own-account USD withdrawal.

flags.title: Foreign-individual FIE dividend exemption repealed
flags.detail: MOF/STA 2026 No. 27 imposes 20% IIT from 2026-09-01. Prior editions' exemption claims are flagged as outdated.

flags.title: Treaty relief and U.S. foreign tax credit are fact-dependent
flags.detail: Beneficial ownership, residence, saving clause and credit limitations prevent automatic full offset.

flags.title: Business routes require real entities/transactions
flags.detail: Entity tax, registration and operational checklists are not fully verified for every route; personal savings cannot be relabelled.

flags.title: Capital reduction/equity sale current checklist not fully extracted
flags.detail: 2024 national PDF extraction stopped before the relevant operational detail; bank checklist required.

flags.title: Cash pooling/outbound lending detailed rules unverified
flags.detail: Only framework verified; not a personal repatriation route.

flags.title: QDII product availability
flags.detail: HSBC lists subscription suspension notices; product-level availability must be checked. QDII is not free USD repatriation.

flags.title: WMC closed loop
flags.detail: Southbound funds return via the same RMB closed loop; not free USD repatriation.

flags.title: Employee plan proceeds return through dedicated structure
flags.detail: Not a general offshore savings retention route.

flags.title: ODI/SPV is investment, not personal spending money
flags.detail: Approvals/filings and later distribution rules apply.

flags.title: Prohibited schemes rejected
flags.detail: Splitting, underground banking, crypto bridges and fake trade are not given execution instructions.

flags.title: Outward gift basis unverified
flags.detail: U.S. Form 3520 reporting is verified, but a general PRC outward-gift entitlement for a domestic relative was not.

flags.title: Revolut/Remitly/Xoom outbound CNY corridor unverified
flags.detail: Inbound-to-China capability is not outbound capability.

flags.title: U.S. 1% remittance tax misapplication
flags.detail: It applies to specified U.S.-outbound physical-instrument-funded remittances, not China-to-U.S. transfers.

flags.title: Personal FX gain character and basis
flags.detail: The USD200 threshold disapplies the exclusion for the transaction; it is not a USD200 deduction. Basis/holding period/personal-vs-investment character require records.

flags.title: FBAR/FATCA history unknown
flags.detail: Prior filings, account maxima and willfulness are unknown. Penalty maxima are ceilings, not predicted annual charges.
